احتجزنا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَجَزْنَا (iḥtajaznā) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒaz.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# اُحْتُجِزْنَا (uḥtujiznā) /uħ.tu.d͡ʒiz.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
